entry.title: When waiting asks too much
entry.summary: A waiting room or café can leave little room for a toddler’s movement and conversation. Davies suggests preparing something to share and adjusting what you expect of the visit.
entry.cue: Your child is restless while the adults need to wait.
detail: Her examples include favorite books, watching the activity outside an airport window, or a small walk together while waiting in a café.
The adult may need to be available for the child instead of reading or making a call. What helps can change during the visit; the aim is to support the child through the wait.
